//: Low Visibility Assault Weapon: SOCOM's suppressed SIG MCX in .300 BLK. Longer barrel than the Rattler SBR, optimized to run quiet with subsonic loads.
description: The Low Visibility Assault Weapon, a special operations carbine built on the SIG MCX and chambered in .300 AAC Blackout.  Its short, gas-piston action was designed from the ground up to run a suppressor with subsonic ammunition, letting an operator put accurate, quiet fire on a target at close range.  A side-folding stock and full-length top rail round out the package.  Feeds from standard STANAG magazines.
//2: Unfolded length. The 9-inch barrel is longer than the Rattler's 5.5 inch tube.

//: Tricked-out LVAW. No rename: shares the base LVAW carbine name; the config is defined entirely by the removable default_mods.
description: A special operations configuration of the LVAW carbine, set up to disappear into the dark: a short suppressor on the muzzle, a holographic sight, a weapon light and an aiming laser on the rails, a vertical foregrip, and a sling.  Quiet, handy, and ready to work.
